name: Withered Commander
description: The Winterworks Withered Commander: a towering wither-skeleton officer, charcoal-grey bones with deep round ember-lit eye sockets, in blackened netherite plate trimmed in gold and split by glowing ember cracks (a crested, plumed helm with a raised slit visor, huge spiked pauldrons, a breastplate over the ribs, greaves and spurred sabatons) under a torn crimson banner cape, holding a long netherite spear with a leaf blade. Minecraft pixel units, density 2: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
